007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.databaseadmin;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.DatabaseAdmin;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
011import org.slf4j.Logger;
012import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
013
014/**
015 * Sample for closing an SDK-owned DatabaseAdmin client.
016 *
017 * <p>This sample demonstrates how to create a {@link DatabaseAdmin} client and
018 * close the SDK-owned JDBC connection deterministically by using
019 * try-with-resources. Administrative methods on {@code DatabaseAdmin} require a
020 * database user authorized to perform the requested setup operation.</p>
021 *
022 * <p>Required environment variables:</p>
023 * <ul>
024 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_USER</li>
025 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD</li>
026 *   <li>SELECTAI_JDBC_URL</li>
027 * </ul>
028 *
029 * <p>Example {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL}:</p>
030 * <pre>{@code
031 * jdbc:oracle:thin:@mydb_high?TNS_ADMIN=/path/to/wallet
032 * }</pre>
033 *
034 * <p>Before compiling or running this sample, build the SDK jar and copy runtime
035 * dependencies. Run the dependency copy command after {@code mvn clean install},
036 * because Maven {@code clean} removes the {@code target/} directory.</p>
037 * <pre>{@code
038 * mvn clean install
039 * mvn -Psamples -DincludeScope=runtime -DoutputDirectory=target/dependency dependency:copy-dependencies
040 * }</pre>
041 *
042 * <p>Compile this sample:</p>
043 * <pre>{@code
044 * javac --release 17 -cp "target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
045 *   -d samples/out \
046 *   samples/src/main/java/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/databaseadmin/CloseDatabaseAdminSample.java
047 * }</pre>
048 *
049 * <p>Run this sample:</p>
050 * <pre>{@code
051 * java -cp "samples/out:target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
052 *   com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.databaseadmin.CloseDatabaseAdminSample
053 * }</pre>
054 *
055 * <p>This sample prints normal result data to standard output so it is easy to
056 * read when run from a terminal. It uses the logger only for error reporting
057 * and diagnostics.</p>
058 */
059public final class CloseDatabaseAdminSample {
060    private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(CloseDatabaseAdminSample.class);
061
062    private CloseDatabaseAdminSample() {
063    }
064
065    public static void main(String[] args) {
066        try (DatabaseAdmin ignored = DatabaseAdmin.create(CreateDatabaseAdminWithOptionsSample.dbConnectionConfig())) {
067            System.out.println("DatabaseAdmin client created; try-with-resources will close it.");
068        } catch (SelectAIException e) {
069            LOGGER.error("Failed to create or close DatabaseAdmin client.", e);
070        }
071    }
072}
